programs.description: Chellakili and Murugan are long-lost lovers who unite when Murugan visits her village disguised as a musician, Murugesh. Chellakili's aunt then devises a sinister plot to separate them.
Maruthu arrives in Mulimalai, claiming kinship to a respected figure, but the village guard, Maayandi, is suspicious. Soon, a murder investigation raises questions about Maruthu's identity.
Navaneetham and Dhanushkodi get married despite their family's disapproval. Later, when he becomes the mayor, his family accepts bribes and puts the blame on Navaneetham.
A woman's sons go to the Kargil war and get martyred. Later, the younger son takes the responsibility of supporting his family.
Kulasekaran, a Casanova, tries to seduce Sangita, but his actions push her away. Later, he falls in love with Archana but is unaware of her real identity.
Thiru, a local gangster, changes his wayward ways after falling in love with an NGO worker. However, his path toward redemption is jeopardised after the police arrest him for his past crimes.
Velusamy, a jobless man, desires to marry his niece Kamatchi. He joins the army to earn a living so that he can marry her. Meanwhile, Kamatchi falls in love with Ramakrishnan, the village postman.
